title: Page 8
lines: 慕容彻身形一震，知道这一切都是自己造成的。冷静过后，清俊的脸上重新扬起一抹笑。
「裴兄，是我误会了璎珞才会做出伤害她的事来，这一点我会亲自向她道歉，并取得她的原谅。」
「不必了。璎珞已说得十分明白，她不想见你，也没有理由再见你了。」裴琥珀暗忖，没想到慕容彻是如此难缠之人，很是后悔自己当初命二妹去找他。
慕容彻笑容不变，微敛的眸底透着冷光，淡道：「裴兄该知解铃仍须系铃人。」
「我只知时间是最好的良药，时日一久，什么都可以被淡忘。」包括再浓烈的感情。
听出裴琥珀的话中之意，慕容彻脸上虽笑，但笑意不及眼底。
「今日先告辞了，我会再来的。」朝他抱拳拱手，衣袍一扬，旋身离开。
裴琥珀望着他离去的背影，心知这男人绝不会放弃二妹，看来这事情棘手了。
「大少爷，二小姐请你过去一趟。」秋月躲在长廊转角处，确定慕容彻主仆离开，这才敢现身。
「好，我这就过去。」大步往璎珞楼而去。
裴琥珀来到璎珞楼前，刚踏进月洞门，即见到二妹站在小院中，似乎已等他有一会了，于是大步走到她面前。
「怎么不在房里等着？」眉头微拧，轻拥着她细肩，扶她回房。
裴璎珞轻笑，任由大哥扶着自己回房，心知自己连续发病吓坏了大家，以致大家都把她当成易碎的陶瓷娃娃般小心呵护着。
「慕容公子走了吗？」
「走了。」裴琥珀扶她在椅子上落坐，跟着在她身旁坐下，注视着她道：「璎珞，你惹上了一个十分难缠厉害的男人。」
「我知道。」裴璎珞苦笑。
「那你就该知道他不会放弃的。」裴琥珀提醒她。
「所以，我要请大哥帮我一个忙。」
「什么忙？」
「我决定嫁给黎大哥。」裴璎珞直视大哥。
「你确定要这样做吗？」裴琥珀俊脸上有抹不赞同。
「十分确定。」
「好，一切交给我了。」如果二妹确定的话，那么身为兄长的他，一定会帮她这个忙的。
「谢谢大哥。」裴璎珞握住大哥的手，知道自己给他添麻烦了。
兄妹俩心照不宣，交换一记只有彼此才懂的目光。
夜深人静，皎洁的月光洒进敞开的窗棂。
绣榻上，熟睡中的柔美娇颜似是困在梦中，小脸纠结摇摆，朱唇低喊出令人揪心的破碎言语：
「……彻……我没有背叛你……没有……」
一声轻叹在房内响起，大掌轻抚过她泪流满面的娇颜，痛苦地低语：「对不起。」
熟睡中的人儿似是被抚上小脸的温热大掌所惊醒，倏地睁开杏眸，翻身坐起。
「是谁？」
当她藉着月光看清站在床榻旁的挺拔身形后，杏眸惊愕大睁，不禁倒抽一口气。
「你瘦了很多。」大掌心疼地抚上她带着病容的小脸。这一切都是他的错，他发誓会用最快的时间养好她的身子。
裴璎珞冷静过后，偏头避开他的大掌，掀开锦被起身离开床榻，拿起披在椅上的披风披上，这才转身面对他。
「慕容公子，你半夜闯进我房里，实非君子应为，还请尽快离开。」柔美小脸面无表情，冷声赶人。
慕容彻含笑的俊脸在听到她的称呼后，笑容僵在脸上，黑眸深沉地注视着她。
「璎珞，对不起。我一时太过忿怒，未查清事实就误会你，才会令你受到伤害。」
「别说了，事情都过去了。夜深了，还请慕容公子尽速离开。」裴璎珞疾步走到房门前，
「你不肯原谅我？」她的态度表现得十分明显——她是不打算原谅他了。
「慕容公子，这段时间我想了很多，我们两个之间的感情发展得太快，以致对彼此不够了解吧！我的确无法原谅你，你对我的不信任，还有伤害的话语，在我心底留下很深的伤痕。我想得很清楚，我们两个不适合，还请你别再为难我，以后我们男婚女嫁各不相干。」
裴璎珞话说得绝情；他的不信任，还有伤害的话语，至今仍是她的梦魇。她真的累了，不想再承受这种痛苦，也不想再让家人担心了。
「所以你决定要嫁给黎尚书的儿子黎耀忠？」慕容彻眨眼间来到她面前，反手将房门关上，一步步逼近她，将她困在他的胸膛和墙壁之间。
「没错。黎大哥温和谦逊，待人客气有礼，绝不会做出伤害我的事来。」裴璎珞杏眸无惧地直视着他，无视他眸底逐渐形成的风暴。
「误会你的事，很抱歉，我会弥补你的，别拿婚姻大事跟我呕气好吗？」慕容彻大掌轻抚她的小脸，极力压抑住胸口的怒气，软声请求。
「慕容公子，请放开我。还有，正如你所言，婚姻大事是何等重要，我绝不会拿它来呕气。这桩婚事是我主动要求，我是真心想要嫁给黎大哥，还望慕容公子成全，别再来找我了。」裴璎珞同样请求他高抬贵手，别再来纠缠她。
「成全？」黑眸狠狠地眯起，瞪视着困在怀里那张柔美坚决的小脸，知道她是认真的，胸口的怒气再也掩藏不住。「好，我成全你！」
话尾刚落，随即点住她的睡穴，双臂接住她软倒的身子，咬牙在她耳畔低吼：「要我成全你，除非我死！」
将她打横抱起，大步走出房门，走没几步，脚步倏地停下，身形未动，低喝：「还不出来！」
乔姥姥从暗处走了出来，目光既激动又含着愧疚，注视着他的背影，砰地一声朝他跪下。
「参见少主。」
「既然她原谅了你，那我就网开一面，随我回灵山岛吧。」慕容彻温柔的目光注视着怀中被点了睡穴的人儿。
乔姥姥简直不敢置信，狂喜地直磕头。「多谢少主——多谢少主！」
眨眼间，三人迅速消失在暗夜里。
「少夫人，我特地做了些荷叶糯米鸡饭，你快来尝尝。」
「是啊！大嫂，小伶的手艺很好的，快来吃吧。」
三人此刻在亭内，裴璎珞望着湖底下悠游的锦鲤，无视两人开心的叫唤。
她自认脾气是三姊妹中最好的，可是再好的脾气，遇到这种事也很难不生气吧！
那晚慕容彻来到她房里，点了她睡穴后，将她强行带走；而她这一睡就睡了十天，昨日回到灵山岛，才被解开睡穴，醒了过来。
由乔姥姥口中得知，慕容彻带着她一路日夜兼程赶路，一会走水路、一会换陆路，总算在最短的时间内将她带回灵山岛，并吩咐众人一律改口唤她少夫人。
这个男人未免太过分了吧！
「大嫂，快来嘛！你昨天到现在都没吃什么东西，快来尝尝小伶的好手艺。」
慕容莹笑得十分开怀，无视她郁闷的脸色，拉着她坐到石椅上，心下暗忖：好在裴璎珞性情温婉脾气好，仅只是从昨日自个儿生着闷气，不会对人乱发脾气。
要是换成她遇到这种事，只怕会捉狂。虽然大哥做得过分了些，不过这次她认同大哥的做法，总比让裴璎珞嫁给别人来得好。
「我不是你的大嫂。」
裴璎珞不知第几回重申，端起已添好的饭碗，迳自低头吃了起来。自小的好修养令她无法对人乱发脾气，可一口气又咽不下，只气得胃口尽失。
慕容莹顽皮地吐舌，与小伶对看一眼，两人心下各松了口气。好在她终于愿意吃饭了。

Murong Che's body trembled, knowing that all this was caused by himself. After calming down, a smile appeared on Qingjun's face again.
"Brother Pei, I misunderstood Yingluo and that's why I did something to hurt her. I will personally apologize to her and obtain her forgiveness."
"No need. Yingluo has made it very clear that she doesn't want to see you and has no reason to see you again." Pei Hubo thought to herself, she didn't expect Murong Che to be such a difficult person, and she regretted that she had ordered her second sister to find him.
Murong Che's smile did not change, and there was a cold light in his slightly restrained eyes, and he said calmly: "Brother Pei should know that the person who untied the bell still has to tie it."
"I only know that time is the best medicine. As time goes by, everything can be forgotten." Including no matter how strong the feelings are.
Hearing the meaning of Pei Hubo's words, Murong Che smiled, but the smile was not as deep as his eyes.
"I'm going to say goodbye today. I'll come back again." He cupped his fists and raised his hands, raised his robe, and turned away.
Pei Hubo looked at his leaving figure, knowing that this man would never give up on his second sister. It seemed that this matter was going to be difficult.
"Young Master, Second Young Lady, please come over." Qiu Yue hid at the corner of the corridor and made sure that Murong Che's master and servant had left before she dared to show up.
"Okay, I'll be there right away." He strode towards Yingluo Tower.
Pei Hubo came to Yingluo Tower and as soon as he stepped into the Moon Cave Gate, he saw his second sister standing in the small courtyard. It seemed that he had been waiting for him for a while, so he strode up to her.
"Why don't you wait in the room?" He frowned slightly, gently hugged her thin shoulders, and helped her back to the room.
Pei Yingluo chuckled and allowed her elder brother to help her back to her room, knowing that her continuous attacks frightened everyone, so much so that everyone took care of her as if she were a fragile porcelain doll.
"Is Mr. Murong gone?"
"Let's go." Pei Hubo helped her sit down on the chair, then sat down next to her, looked at her and said, "Yingluo, you have provoked a very difficult and powerful man."
"I know." Pei Yingluo smiled bitterly.
"Then you should know that he will not give up." Pei Hubo reminded her.
"So, I want to ask big brother to do me a favor."
"What's the deal?"
"I decided to marry Brother Li." Pei Yingluo looked directly at her brother.
"Are you sure you want to do this?" Pei Hupojun said with disapproval on his face.
"Absolutely sure."
"Okay, leave everything to me." If the second sister is sure, then as the elder brother, he will definitely help her with this.
"Thank you, brother." Pei Yingluo held her brother's hand, knowing that she had caused him trouble.
The brother and sister understood each other tacitly, exchanging glances that only each other could understand.
In the dead of night, the bright moonlight shines through the open window lattice.
On the embroidered couch, the sleeping soft and beautiful face seemed to be trapped in a dream, her little face was tangled and swaying, and her red lips whispered heart-wrenching and broken words:
"...Toru...I didn't betray you...no..."
A soft sigh resounded in the room, a big palm gently touched her tear-stained face, and she whispered painfully: "I'm sorry."
The sleeping person seemed to be awakened by the warm palms touching his face. He suddenly opened his almond eyes and turned over to sit up.
"Who is it?"
When she saw clearly the tall figure standing next to the bed through the moonlight, her almond-shaped eyes widened in shock and she couldn't help but gasp.
"You've lost a lot of weight." His big palm caressed her sickly little face. This was all his fault, and he vowed to take good care of her as soon as possible.
After Pei Yingluo calmed down, she turned her head to avoid his big palm, lifted up the brocade quilt, stood up and left the bed, picked up the cloak draped on the chair and put it on before turning to face him.
"Mr. Murong, you broke into my room in the middle of the night, which is not what a gentleman should do. Please leave as soon as possible." His soft little face was expressionless, and he chased me away in a cold voice.
After hearing her address, Murong Che's smiling handsome face froze with a smile, and his black eyes stared at her deeply.
"Yingluo, I'm sorry. I was too angry at the moment and misunderstood you before I found out the facts, which made you hurt."
"Stop talking, everything is over. It's late at night, please leave Master Murong as soon as possible." Pei Yingluo walked quickly to the door.
"You won't forgive me?" Her attitude was very obvious - she was not going to forgive him.
"Mr. Murong, I have thought a lot during this time. The relationship between the two of us has developed so fast that we don't understand each other well enough! I really can't forgive you. Your distrust of me and your hurtful words have left deep scars in my heart. I think very clearly that the two of us are not suitable. Please don't embarrass me anymore. From now on, we will have nothing to do with each other."
Pei Yingluo spoke ruthlessly; his distrust and hurtful words are still her nightmare. She was really tired and didn't want to bear this pain anymore, nor did she want to worry her family anymore.
"So you decided to marry Li Yaozhong, the son of Li Shangshu?" Murong Che came to her in the blink of an eye, closed the door with his backhand, and approached her step by step, trapping her between his chest and the wall.
"That's right. Brother Li is gentle and humble, polite and courteous to others, and will never do anything to hurt me." Pei Yingluo looked directly at him fearlessly, ignoring the storm that was gradually forming in his eyes.
"I misunderstood you. I'm sorry. I will make it up to you. Don't get angry with me about the marriage, okay?" Murong Che gently stroked her face with his big palm, trying his best to suppress the anger in his chest, and asked softly.
"Mr. Murong, please let me go. And, as you said, marriage is so important. I will never take it to get angry. I requested this marriage. I really want to marry Brother Li. I hope Mr. Murong will fulfill his wish and stop coming to me." Pei Yingluo also asked him to be noble and stop pestering her.
"Chengcheng?" His black eyes narrowed fiercely, staring at the soft and determined little face trapped in his arms, knowing that she was serious, and the anger in his chest could no longer be hidden. "Okay, I'll make it happen for you!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he touched her sleeping point, caught her limp body with his arms, gritted his teeth and growled in her ear: "You want me to fulfill your wish, unless I die!"
He picked her up in his arms and strode out of the room. After walking a few steps, he stopped suddenly without moving and shouted, "Don't come out yet!"
Grandma Qiao walked out of the darkness, her eyes filled with excitement and guilt. She stared at his back and knelt down towards him with a bang.
"See Young Master."
"Since she has forgiven you, I'll be more generous and come with me back to Lingshan Island." Murong Che's gentle eyes looked at the person who had his sleeping hole tapped in his arms.
Grandma Qiao couldn't believe it and kowtowed in ecstasy. "Thank you, young master - thank you, young master!"
In the blink of an eye, the three people quickly disappeared into the dark night.
"Madam, I specially made some lotus leaf glutinous rice chicken rice, come and try it."
"Yes! Sister-in-law, Xiaoling's cooking is very good. Come and eat."
The three of them were in the pavilion at the moment. Pei Yingluo looked at the koi carp swimming leisurely under the lake, ignoring the two people's happy calls.
She thinks she has the best temper among the three sisters, but no matter how good her temper is, it's hard not to get angry when things like this happen!
That night Murong Che came to her room, clicked on her sleeping hole, and took her away by force; she slept for ten days, and when she returned to Lingshan Island yesterday, she was unlocked from her sleeping hole and woke up.
Grandma Qiao learned that Murong Che took her on a journey day and night, sometimes by waterway, sometimes by land, and finally brought her back to Lingshan Island in the shortest possible time, and ordered everyone to change their names to call her Young Madam.
This man is going too far!
"Sister-in-law, come on! You haven't eaten anything since yesterday. Come and try Xiaoling's good craftsmanship."
Murong Ying smiled heartily, ignoring her depressed expression, and pulled her to sit on the stone chair, thinking to herself: Fortunately, Pei Yingluo has a gentle temperament and a good temper. She was just sulky since yesterday and would not lose her temper with others.
If this happened to her, she would probably go crazy. Although the eldest brother went too far, she agreed with his approach this time, which was better than letting Pei Yingluo marry someone else.
"I'm not your sister-in-law."
Pei Yingluo reiterated her words for no idea how many times. She picked up the rice bowl and started eating. Her good manners since she was a child prevented her from losing her temper with others, but she couldn't hold it in her mouth and was so angry that she lost her appetite.
Murong Ying stuck out her tongue playfully, and looked at Xiao Ling, and both of them breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, she was finally willing to eat.
